verify_otp.doc: Verify the 2FA OTP for a pending OAuth sign-in and finalize the session.

resend_otp.doc: Resend the 2FA OTP email for a pending OAuth sign-in.

cancel_otp.doc: Abandon a pending OAuth 2FA sign-in (Back to sign in): delete the otp_pending cookie so the signin page no longer bounces to the OTP screen.
